A procedure text explains how to do or use something through clear, ordered steps. Its purpose is to help readers complete a task or use a product correctly.
A procedure text has a goal, tools or materials, and steps. Add tips or warnings when they are relevant.
Use imperative sentences: base verb plus object. For example: Choose a clear product photo. Use sequence words: first, next, then, finally.
